_om: Kodeknekkeren in English (Codebreaker, rusj.no/en/codebreaker/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Two teams, Team Pink and Team Blue, look for their secret agents among 25 words; each team's code master («kodemester») gives one word and a number. «Fella» is the trap, «nøytrale ord» the neutral words, «Sammen mot fella» the co-op mode (Beat the Trap). The words come from the English word bank (data/kategorier.en). Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
